capabilities_done: (1) downmix: >2 channels (or any ImportOptions::channel_map) fold to stereo by Rec. ITU-R BS.775-4 Annex 4 Table 2 3/2->2/0 (L' = L + 0.7071 C + 0.7071 LS, R' = R + 0.7071 C + 0.7071 RS; LFE omitted, Table 2 has no LFE term), coefficients read from the ITU PDF of BS.775-4 (12/2022) this session; Studio rule (not from the Recommendation) assigns SL/BL->LS, SR/BR->RS, BC->0.7071 into LS and RS, FLC/FRC->L/R; normalize_downmix divides by the largest coefficient sum; speaker layout from reel DecodedAudio::speakers (FLAC RFC 9639 9.1.3, Vorbis I 4.3.9 for Vorbis/Opus, AAC configs 1-6, WAV extensible mask; orders checked against RFC 9639 and the Vorbis I spec this session) or the caller's channel_map (Speaker::Unused drops a channel); unknown order = audio_channel_map_required

(2) FLAC export: MD5 of the streamed samples written into STREAMINFO at reel::audio::flac::STREAMINFO_MD5_OFFSET after streaming (export needs Write + Seek); reel re-decode reports checksum_verified Some(true); independent oracle: ffmpeg 8.1.1 decode of the viewer's exported FLAC to s24le, Python hashlib MD5 3e7d74e0c3404bc617012b498c4700a8 == STREAMINFO MD5 (13230 frames)

(3) WAV: reel decode_audio_file takes RIFF/WAVE (PCM 8/16/24/32, float 32/64, A-law, mu-law, WAVE_FORMAT_EXTENSIBLE sub-format + mask; RF64 typed refusal; short data chunk decodes the frames present) through the AIFF reader's new little-endian encodings; decoder id wav-riff-pcm; harness import_audio / open_audio_file / Viewer take it unchanged

(4) viewer: Viewer::open routes audio files (reel::audio::sniff_audio_file, only when the image/document import does not claim the bytes) to view::audio_import: audio panel (widgets audio.panel, audio.export_flac, audio.export_aiff), program monitor on the import sequence at the file rate, state_json.audio, Viewer::export_audio (temp file + rename, never over the opened file), Viewer::audio_mix_stream for a host's audio_out

(5) batch: view::audio_batch (feature audio-batch): AudioBatchJob {input, output, overwrite, artifact, ImportOptions, ImportLimits, chain: Vec<EffectSpec{Gain, Equalizer, Dynamics, Limiter}>, MixFormat}; AudioBatchQueue after reel ExportQueue (submit -> handle with progress {state queued|importing|processing|encoding|complete|failed|canceled, done/total frames} and cancel, run in submission order, per-item AudioBatchReceipt with import projection, score chain identity, bounce digest, latency dropped, export receipt, output SHA-256, verified); refusals before reading input (output_path, output_exists, effect_chain, export_format); output published only after reel re-decode (frames, channels, FLAC MD5) via sibling .hsk-partial temp file renamed on success, removed on failure/cancel
